haircut.words:
You have exactly one rule for me.
Don't you dare get a haircut and i have broken it everytime.
So now there’s somebody in your life who you love the most,
and who does not listen to a word you say.
It’s me. It’s about my hair. I’m going again tomorrow.
Just kidding i dont have the balls to go bald again

may23.words:
23rd May. Your data was off, so I decided you were asleep.
I waited outside yours. Then I gave up and left.
Halfway there I checked a phone that had made no sound at all.
A text. A missed call. You are ready and waiting for mee.
I have never turned a scooter around that fast.
You were still standing there when I got back.
You got on. We went to work. I said very little.
I had to leave for Bombay by midday. We kept texting anyway.
You said it was temporary. A few more days and you were gone.
So I said fine. I’ll enjoy it while it lasts. Someone else will sit there.
You were furious, which was the entire point.
Nobody replaces you. I’ll text and call and annoy you wherever you go.
That night you felt like the lazy intern who knew nothing.
So I wrote you something long.
You told me later this was the day you were sure.

may28.words:
I didn’t sleep. I wrote you a letter instead.
It took most of the night, and I meant every line of it.
Came in early. Picked you up. Said nothing about it.
Then handed it back over my shoulder while you sat behind me.
You went very red and didn’t speak for a while.
Then the same office. The same desk. The same work.
Nothing about that day was the same.
I was nervous the whole time, but i wud still love to live that day again.

may29.words:
29th May. Two questions. No lying.
I have forgotten the first one, which I am sorry about.
The second was: what are we.
I did not have an answer.
You had to tell me that the correct move was to ask you.
So I asked you. 
Will you be my girlfriend!?
You said yes. Best thing that happened to me

weeks.words:
Nothing changed. Except all of it did.
We had just spent the whole day sitting beside in the same office.
It made no difference at all.
12 - 12:30 - 1 - 1:30 - 2
Kept saying goodnight bye bye, but the conversation never ended
And sacrificing all that sleep was soo worth itt.

brownies.words:
You told me to bake you brownies.
You were joking. I chose not to notice.
I made them 3rd June morning, before work.
And then I handed you a letter instead.
It apologised, at some length, for not getting you brownies.
“Did you really think I wouldn’t get you something you asked for?”
Then the brownies.

vegas.words:
Welcome to fabulous Las Vegas.
The Strip, all lit up. Every single light of it is on for you.
You pull the lever. Three sevens. Obviously.
Then the Bellagio fountains, right on the music. We watch every show.
And we walk the Strip at 2am like it is the middle of the day.
Stay as long as you like.

rounds.words:
Six o’clock, and neither of us in any hurry.
Some days it was ice cream.
Some days it was Aarey, which is not on the way to anywhere.
The road was dark and i always wished there was traffic so that i get to spend more time with you.
And then your gate. Eventually. Always eventually.
